# Every call site that decodes input in a non-test file of the tree
# (tests.generated.1): the file, the function that holds the call (a method as
# Type.name, a closure as the function around it), and the fuzz target of that
# package that reaches it. internal/decoders_test.go reads this list: a decode
# call on no row is red, and so is a row whose target is not a func Fuzz of the
# file's package, or whose function decodes nothing.
#
# A target of "-" is a site with none: the rest of the row says why, and a row
# of none with no reason is red. It is taken only in a package that has a fuzz
# target of its own; a package with none is waived only by a row of
# gate/exemptions.yaml, and a package that file exempts from tests.generated.1
# has no rows here.
#
# file	function	target
cmd/gragas-dev/hook.go	parseGoPrivate	FuzzParseGoPrivate
cmd/gragas-dev/hook.go	parseStore	FuzzParseStore
cmd/gragas-dev/presetplugins.go	readPresetCheck	FuzzReadPresetCheck
cmd/gragas-dev/surface.go	withContractPackage	-	the surface diff's read of the export list gragas-generate writes in the tree
cmd/gragas-release/built.go	readBuilt	FuzzReadBuilt
cmd/gragas-release/draft.go	readReleases	FuzzReadReleases
internal/core/api/guard_hook.go	ParseHookEdit	FuzzParseHookEdit
internal/core/api/guard_hook.go	oneKeyEach	FuzzParseHookEdit
internal/core/api/journal.go	groups	FuzzJournalDetails
internal/core/api/journal.go	outcomeOf	FuzzJournalDetails
internal/core/api/journal_restore.go	JournalRestore	FuzzJournalDetails
internal/core/api/journal_restore.go	leftBy	FuzzJournalDetails
internal/dev/census/census.go	FirstClass	FuzzFirstClass
internal/dev/generate/reads.go	parseConsumer	FuzzGenerateConsumer
internal/dev/layers/usesmatrix.go	textList.UnmarshalJSON	FuzzTheReadersOfTheRegisterAndTheUsesFiles
internal/dev/layers/usesmatrix.go	Uses.CompareMatrix	FuzzTheReadersOfTheRegisterAndTheUsesFiles
internal/dev/standin/answer.go	Answer	FuzzServe
internal/dev/standin/answer.go	Serve	FuzzServe
internal/dev/tokens/tokens.go	Parse	FuzzParseTokens
internal/host/fs/journal.go	records	FuzzTheJournalReader
internal/host/fs/journal.go	older	FuzzTheJournalReader
internal/host/term/palette.go	ParsePalette	FuzzParsePalette
internal/port/testing/world_files.go	journalPort.RecordsOf	FuzzTheWorldsJournalReader
internal/ordered/yaml.go	decodeOne	FuzzParseYAML
